notes: Starting cards as posted under Start (9): Court Of The Vile Gangster (the back side's name is replaced by a joke in the post), Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer, Watto's Box and Start Your Engines! (posted as placed in the Reserve Deck); these count toward the 60. The post says to start Allegations Of Corruption instead of Watto's Box against podracing opponents.
Posted 'Tat Podrace Arena', 'JP Audience Chamber' and 'Boonta Eve Podrace' dested the Dark printings (the plain pages are Light).

Posted 'Tusken Raider' dested the Dark Coruscant Tusken Raider (Dark): the strategy has it 'shoot' destiny off the opponent's Podracer at the Podrace Arena, which is that card's text, not the Premiere one's.

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; '4-LOM w/ gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Mara Jade' / 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand / Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Maul's Saber' Maul's Lightsaber; 'ZiMH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'BFiS1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Executor DB' / 'D2 DB' Executor: Docking Bay / Death Star II: Docking Bay.

Posted 'Ghhhk & TRWEU' dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'IAO & Secret Plans' Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans; 'Search & Destroy' Search And Destroy.
A strategy update in the post suggests removing one You Cannot Hide Forever for Come Here You Big Coward and one Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba for a second Janus Greejatus; the list is kept as published.

The description and strategy say the pre-Coruscant version went 4-0 (+119) at the Atlanta DPC; this post-Coruscant list was not played there, so it is a general DeckTech list. The strategy update gives a 16-1 overall record.
